description: Skill library maintenance: audit, merge, rename, delete, consolidate, publish, sanitize, and critique skills. Interactive menu via clarify tool. Scans ALL profile directories recursively — never hardcodes a single path. Use when the user asks to clean up the skill library, merge overlapping skills, rename skills to follow naming conventions, delete auto-generated or stale skills, audit skills for authorship, publish skills to external registries, sanitize skills for security scanner compliance, score skills against the 10-dimension rubric, generate improvement plans, or run autonomous library grinding (10khr). Also covers frontmatter conventions and how to identify skills by type (ocas-*, util-*, protected, auto-generated). NOT for: building or debugging a skill's own scripts (that is not a library task), running code autofix on skill source, or writing arbitrary code unrelated to the skill library.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
